core_obligations: Reduce to sheaves: f_! is exact so it suffices to check constructible sheaves; the question is local on Y so assume Y affine, whence X is quasi-compact and quasi-separated and admits a finite affine open covering (proof lines 4696-4703).

Reduce to separated f: by the colimit description of lower shriek it suffices to handle the pieces f_{i,!} and f_{ii',!}; their sources are quasi-compact and separated, so f may be assumed separated (proof lines 4704-4710).

Factor and conclude: Zariski's main theorem gives f = g after j with j an open immersion and g finite of finite presentation; f_! = g_! after j_!, j_!F is constructible, g_! = g_* for finite g, and finite pushforward preserves constructibility (proof lines 4711-4725).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to constructible sheaves and affine localization (proof lines 4696-4703).
Reduction to separated f via the colimit description over the covering (proof lines 4704-4710).
Zariski main theorem factorization and constructibility on both factors (proof lines 4711-4725).
